scenes.title: B1 Hook: endless tabs
scenes.description: Mock browser, tabs spawn fast: LinkedIn Jobs, Google Sheets job tracker, ChatGPT cover letter, Gmail. Cursor darts. Type: 'busy work'. [Remotion mock browser]
scenes.vo: There's a lot of busy work when it comes to getting a job, especially now in this job market. It's rough.
scenes.notes: Remotion. Must work as standalone hook for cutdowns. | VO 0.7-6.3 | audio: assets/recordings/TKE.m4a

scenes.title: B2 Busywork montage
scenes.description: One idea per shot ~1s: Finding=job board doomscroll · Resume=resume-v7-FINAL-final.docx save dialog · Cover letter=ChatGPT regenerating · Networking=LinkedIn Connect clicks · Applying=Workday login. Word stamps each shot. [Remotion mocks]
scenes.vo: You have to find the job, write the resume, the cover letter, network with people in the office, and even applying to it is a huge pain in the ass.

scenes.title: B3 Hundreds of hours
scenes.description: Nick desk timelapse day-to-night, coffee cups pile up. Insert: iOS screen-time card (LinkedIn 11h · Sheets 6h · ChatGPT 9h). Big type: 'Hundreds of hours.'
scenes.vo: Hundreds of hours are wasted on boring, repetitive work just to get that one offer.
scenes.notes: NICK FILMS timelapse. Screen-time card Remotion. | VO 14.6-19.4 | audio: assets/recordings/TKE.m4a

scenes.title: B4 Turn: let Scout take over
scenes.description: All tabs/sheets/docs sweep off screen leaving one clean Offerloop window on #F5F6F8. Beat of calm.
scenes.vo: Fuck that. Instead, let Scout take care of all of it.
scenes.notes: Remotion. | VO 20.4-20.8 ('Fuck that.' record-scratch, bleep for paid) + 21.6-23.7 | audio: assets/recordings/TKE.m4a

scenes.title: B5 Logo hero
scenes.description: Wordmark assembles letter by letter, hero line: Search. Reach out. Get hired.
scenes.notes: Music swell, no VO. Remotion. | music swell, no VO | audio: assets/recordings/TKE.m4a
